## Checklist

- [ ] Tests added or updated (`npm test`, `npm run test:integration`, `e2e/`)
- [ ] `npm run lint` and `npm run typecheck` pass
- [ ] No secrets, tokens, or PII committed (gitleaks clean)
- [ ] CSP / RBAC / RLS / SSRF guards untouched, or explicitly reviewed
- [ ] No new third-party SDK that collects user data without privacy review
- [ ] Docs updated (`README.md`, `docs/`, or `CHANGELOG.md`) when user-visible behavior changes
